Moridin's soul is not dead.

He is Ishamael, Betrayer of Hope, he cannot be killed, actually. He is bound to the Wheel just as poor Lews Therin the eternal Champion of the Light. They are doomed to continious rebirth, grieving over somebody or something.

Elan also wants to quit, maybe even more  than Lews Therin. It's his special punishment from the Dark Lord that he has to come back. Maybe his soul is already out in another body, as he has never been bound. Kinslayer is fated to grieve for his family and for all his mistakes, then slowly discovering that somebody else is in his head talking to him, then pain, agony, seeking for final death, understanding that it will never be final, then winning over the Dark Lord, dying again and again, and again, and again, till the end of Time. :)
